description: This file defines an interface IAppLogger<T> in the namespace Microsoft.eShopWeb.ApplicationCore.Interfaces. The interface provides methods for logging information and warnings, abstracting away dependencies on specific ASP.NET Core logging types.

classes.name: IAppLogger<T>
